mention_query.caption: Mention query
mention_query.doc: Fires (debounced ~150ms) when the user types after the trigger character. Read current_query, then update the Candidates field with matching results.
mention_query.name: mention_query

mention_inserted.caption: Mention inserted
mention_inserted.doc: Fires when the user selects a mention from the popup. Read mention_id, mention_label, and mention_type.
mention_inserted.name: mention_inserted

submit.caption: Submit
submit.doc: Fires when the user presses Enter (without Shift). Read plain_text and current_mentions to get the message content.
submit.name: submit

inp_ext_mention.caption: Mention
inp_ext_mention.doc: Enable @mention support. When enabled, typing the trigger character opens a suggestion popup.
inp_ext_mention.name: ext_mention

inp_trigger_char.caption: Trigger character
inp_trigger_char.doc: The character that triggers the mention popup. Default is @.
inp_trigger_char.name: trigger_char

inp_candidates.caption: Candidates (JSON)
inp_candidates.doc: Reactive JSON array of candidates: [{"id":"...","label":"...","type":"...","sublabel":"..."}]. Update in response to the Mention query event. type and sublabel are optional.
inp_candidates.name: candidates

inp_initial_content.caption: Initial content
inp_initial_content.doc: HTML content to load into the editor on initialisation. Stored mention nodes round-trip correctly when read-only mode is on.
inp_initial_content.name: initialContent

inp_placeholder.caption: Placeholder
inp_placeholder.doc: Placeholder text shown when the editor is empty.
inp_placeholder.name: placeholder

inp_is_editable.caption: Editable
inp_is_editable.doc: When false the editor is read-only — use this to render stored messages containing mentions.
inp_is_editable.name: isEditable

inp_mention_border_color.caption: Mention border color
inp_mention_border_color.doc: Border color of rendered mention chips.
inp_mention_border_color.name: mention_border_color

inp_mention_bg_color.caption: Mention background color
inp_mention_bg_color.doc: Background color of rendered mention chips.
inp_mention_bg_color.name: mention_background_color

inp_current_query.caption: Current query
inp_current_query.doc: Text typed after the trigger character. Read this in Mention query handler to filter candidates.
inp_current_query.name: current_query

inp_current_mentions.caption: Current mentions (JSON)
inp_current_mentions.doc: JSON array of mention nodes in the document, deduped by id, document order. Format: [{"id":"...","label":"...","type":"..."}].
inp_current_mentions.name: current_mentions

inp_plain_text.caption: Plain text
inp_plain_text.doc: Plain text content of the editor, with mentions rendered as @label.
inp_plain_text.name: plain_text

inp_serialized_value.caption: Serialized value (HTML)
inp_serialized_value.doc: Full HTML of the editor content. Store this and feed it back as Initial content to restore mentions.
inp_serialized_value.name: serialized_value

inp_mention_id.caption: Mention: inserted ID
inp_mention_id.doc: ID of the most recently inserted mention.
inp_mention_id.name: mention_id

inp_mention_label.caption: Mention: inserted label
inp_mention_label.doc: Label of the most recently inserted mention.
inp_mention_label.name: mention_label

inp_mention_type.caption: Mention: inserted type
inp_mention_type.doc: Type of the most recently inserted mention.
inp_mention_type.name: mention_type
